draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.86, the 189th-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 14th of 21 at S. He went 152nd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (189th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 77 tackles in 2018, 6th of 21 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2021. 19 career games and 1 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2021. Weak spots: passes defended 0 (8th percentile), approximate value 1 (11th percentile). Played 10 of 17 games in 2021.
